intro: Tourism, bauxite and money from Jamaicans abroad drive the economy.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Beach resorts in Montego Bay and Negril attract millions. Bauxite and alumina are exported, and Blue Mountain coffee is among the most expensive in the world.

chapters.title: Music industry
text: Music is a big cultural export.

keyTerms.meaning: Processed bauxite used to make aluminium.

cardGroups.title: Made in Jamaica
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Jamaica makes and sells to the world.
